objective: Reuse existing CircuitDna AXCG0001 and NumericExecution to birth numerical capabilities without serializing foundry training/admission examples, names, contexts or optimizer state. This is an architectural prerequisite for a language/math bridge, not full M1 completion.
representation: Explicit new portable catalog kind18, existing AXCG0001 payload, maximum65536 bytes. Existing kinds0..17 and formats unchanged. Global genome/page/authority quotas never enlarged. Runtime retains compiled NumericExecution only, not an EvolvedSkill/NumericSkill witness archive. Same partial floating-point arithmetic and finite/domain guards.
scope: Source-program export references the existing numerical foundry and compiler, not another solver. It does not guarantee arbitrary learned programs contain no sensitive information: an induced constant can encode a fact. Only authorized capabilities may be exported; explicit private journals/examples must not be copied.
context: The existing AXCG format uses explicit generic runtime context axon/constructive-v1, not the original skill's semantic context. CLI export must validate the source context before writing; caller must rebind units/meaning/authority explicitly. Arithmetic/domain guards are preserved, not a semantic-context or privacy certificate.
preflight: Program conversion preserves expression, arity and bits/domain errors through serialization and compilation
Different witness/name/context histories yielding the same program yield the same executable DNA
Separate-process/demand birth from numeric genome without original data files
Strict parser, canonical genes, cycles/forward references, checksum and quota failures remain refusals
Authority/context and active-module/byte limits preserved; rejected requests cannot authorize effects
regression: Focused numeric/demand/genome and full Rust tests, clippy, minimal build, legacy public numeric seed replay and existing language/math/context retention. Record all negative tests and full immutable source/binary evidence. No old numeric format silently reinterpreted.
measurement: Report serialized module versus witness-bearing source and retained compiled bytes. Decode scratch/stack and full process/IO costs remain distinct; do not claim physical speed, RSS or energy improvements without matched measurements.
source: GSM8K partition and answer-access audit remain frozen. This module qualification reads no GSM answer property, performs no word-problem training/evaluation and cannot report a GSM score.
demo_controls: Old witness-bearing predictor, exported circuit-number predictor and new genome-number demand predictor on the same8 declared queries. Freeze before fitting. Move the original catalog/payload directory aside after packing; demand predictions must then use only the packed number and fresh birth directories. Invalid values, context, id and numeric kind mismatch are refusals; record any authorized local birth files even on a failed query. These are same-author numerical regression cases, not new mathematical discoveries or independent public language tests.
